supports: deterministic Rule execution and replay integrity

dataset_limitations: The twelve frozen records are predominantly secondary commentary, translated summaries and truncated page captures with scraper chrome. SRC001/SRC005 are near duplicates; several records stop mid-sentence near 3,500 characters.

SRC012 contains case and timing claims inconsistent with the Draft. SRC009 is dated after the Draft's 2025-09-15 endpoint and is the main stored account for the asserted final compromise. No source is independently reconciled.
The Draft spans August 2020 to September 2025. Twenty-two logical coordinates preserve selected ordering and communication dependencies but do not estimate legal, political or platform time.

P_3 aggregates distinct federal courts as a representation gate, and P_5 aggregates state governments, public institutions and legislative proponents. No judicial preference, state uniformity, legislator vote or internal mandate is modeled.

Seven ByteDance rows describe receipt or target status rather than autonomous action. Draft E2/E4/E5/E6/E7/E10 relation endpoints are misdirected or omit the stated owner; actor-local rows and coherent narrative govern current authority.

The final data-operation and algorithm-authorization arrangement is recorded only as qualified participant positions. No operator selection, data transfer, algorithm licensing, ownership change, legal implementation or durable settlement is simulated.
No user behavior, content recommendation, data flow, speech effect, national-security risk, valuation, sale process, enforcement, device compliance or platform-impact model exists.

Full Draft exposure and authored logical-time compression preclude unbiased prediction, historical fit, calibration, policy or speech effects, held-out evaluation, causal or scientific-validity claims.
